question: On the same models, items and harness, does gstack plus the idea 1 ledger send fewer needless asks than gstack today, without holding back more needed asks?
decision_table: If the ledger arm cuts needless asks without missing must-asks, the ledger gets built in gstack and the prose rule is trimmed.
If gstack today matches the ledger, the ledger is dropped.
If the no-gstack arm does as well as both, the quiet and ask rules become a cut candidate, which Garry hears plainly (R48).
temperature: provider default (no temperature field is sent)

caching.anthropic: cache_control ephemeral breakpoints at the end of the system prefix and at the end of the user content, so replicate 2 of a cell reads the whole prompt from cache
caching.openai: the provider's automatic prefix caching; the request sets no cache field
caching.openrouter: the endpoint's own caching where it has one; the request sets no cache field
caching.replicates: a cell (item, arm, model) runs its replicates in sequence: replicate r+1 starts only after replicate r has a sealed reply or a final MISSING; arm cells keep their seeded random order within each item, and different cells and items run in parallel

window.cut_note: Older messages in this thread were cut to fit.

ledger.addendum: Before you send an ask, read the ledger and name the row it repeats, or say new.

safety_stop.openai: a refusal content part or refusal field, finish_reason content_filter, or incomplete_details.reason content_filter

pilot.spread_formula: W is the mean over needless items of the unbiased variance of (b)'s k samples; V is the unbiased variance across needless items of (b)'s item means; B2 = max(0, V - W/k_pilot), the variance of (b)'s true item rates, stands for the variance of the true paired difference (the difference when the ledger arm holds back what (b) sends); projected P1 spread S(k) = sqrt(B2 + 2*W/k), with the treatment arm's within-item variance taken equal to (b)'s; projected MDD(k) = 2.8 * S(k) / sqrt(proxy effective clusters on needless items); k = 3 when MDD(2) > 0.12
pilot.draw: 16 must-ask and 24 needless items, each spread over its (class, thread) strata in proportion to their sizes by largest remainder with a random tie order, drawn at random within each stratum
pilot.seed: minted from random bytes at the draw (ask-replay draw --kind pilot) and recorded in CUSTODY.md

label_audit.seed: minted from random bytes at the draw (ask-replay draw --kind audit) and recorded in CUSTODY.md
label_audit.draw: 40 must-ask and 40 duplicates at random within class, plus every permission and observable item (ask-replay draw --kind audit)
